$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Constrains config.deployment, config.features and config.administratorRecovery.

mode.description: Only processed with the recovery feature on. Check is read-only; apply grants access.

expectedMembers.description: Optional active team roster count; mismatch refuses without recovery writes.

organization.description: Organization ID or exact slug; optional only for one organization.

team.description: Designated non-SCIM Admin team ID or exact name.

teams.description: Alternative organization ID or slug to team ID or name map.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

nativeAffordanceCodeMode.description: OpenWork commands in Code Mode: Let assistants compose OpenWork queries and sidebar commands in Code Mode using the same checked app actions. Renders DEN_FEATURE_NATIVE_AFFORDANCE_CODE_MODE.

libraryConnectorNavigation.description: Library: connected items and skill previews: Open assigned connectors in My Library from Manage and expand skills in plugins and My Library. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LIBRARY_CONNECTOR_NAVIGATION.

mcpAppLibraries.description: Apps: built-in libraries: Apps built in OpenWork can use icons, charts, animation, 3D and SVG drawing from pinned libraries bundled into each App, with no remote scripts or network access. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MCP_APP_LIBRARIES.

autoRouter.description: AI Gateway: Auto Router: Admins describe when to use each AI Gateway model, and members can pick Auto: each prompt goes to the model and thinking level that fits it best. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTO_ROUTER.

mermaidZoom.description: Desktop: zoom into diagrams: Mermaid diagrams in chat and file previews can be zoomed, panned and opened full screen so large diagrams are readable. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MERMAID_ZOOM.

administratorRecovery.description: Deploy-time administrator recovery: Run a one-time, operator-selected Admin-team permission repair at deployment; disabling stops future repairs, not existing grants. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ADMINISTRATOR_RECOVERY.

nativeDictation.description: Native dictation: Dictate editable prompts in OpenWork and Workbot using native desktop dictation or live browser speech recognition. Renders DEN_FEATURE_NATIVE_DICTATION.

sandboxOrgs.description: Sandbox organizations: Platform admins create try-it-out organizations from /admin with fictional workplace connectors, included models and a shareable join link that expires. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SANDBOX_ORGS.

connectionMcpServers.description: Connect: an MCP server for each connection: Members can add one connected service, such as Gmail or Linear, to an agent like Claude Code as its own MCP server that lists only that service's tools. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CONNECTION_MCP_SERVERS.

slackSendAsBot.description: Connect: Slack messages from the OpenWork bot: Chats and Automations can send a Slack message from the OpenWork app instead of as the member: a DM that notifies them ("ping me when this is done") or a channel post that names whose agent sent it. Needs the OpenWork app in Slack; limited to 20 messages a day per member. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_SEND_AS_BOT.

liveProviderSync.description: Live provider sync: Keep desktop OpenCode v2 models up to date with the organization's AI Gateway in real time. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LIVE_PROVIDER_SYNC.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own AWS account or Google Cloud project and see its health and updates in OpenWork, and agents connected to OpenWork can create and follow those deployments. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

workbotDocuments.description: Workbot Documents: Members browse recent Google Drive files and folders in Workbot, open documents in tabs, and save supported text and spreadsheet edits to Drive. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENTS.

workbotDocumentEditing.description: Workbot Documents: editing: Members choose Edit from a document preview. Full Office editing starts their Cloud workspace only when requested. Requires Workbot Documents. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENT_EDITING.

workbotWorkspaceAssistant.description: Workbot: workspace assistant: Members ask Workbot about the document or calendar view they have open, chat without leaving their work, and navigate from a compact sidebar. Workbot offers to open the documents it mentions, and the conversation stays open beside the document. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_WORKSPACE_ASSISTANT.

workbotProactive.description: Workbot: Your agent: Every member gets a background agent that reads their Gmail and Google Calendar each morning and about every three hours in working hours, and sends them one short DM from the Workbot Slack app only when something needs them. Admins turn it on and choose what it tells people about in Manage › Workbot; members turn it off, snooze it or mute a kind of message. It only reads and never sends, accepts or edits anything for them. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_PROACTIVE.

workbotAgentHealthView.description: Workbot: Your agent health in Manage › Workbot: Admins see, for the last 7 days and per responsibility, how many checks members' agents ran, the share that stayed quiet, how many messages they sent and how many members muted it. Counts only, no member names or content. Needs Workbot: Your agent. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_AGENT_HEALTH_VIEW.

workbotIncludedModels.description: Workbot: included OpenWork models by default: Signed-in members chat in Workbot on their included OpenWork models without an AI Gateway provider. When the free allowance runs out, Workbot says when it resets and links admins to OpenWork Models or the workspace's model settings. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_INCLUDED_MODELS.

workbotUsageRecovery.description: Workbot: usage limits and upgrades: Signed-in Workbot uses free Auto or the member’s paid Models Luna entitlement, with allowance recovery and permission-aware upgrades in the conversation. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_USAGE_RECOVERY.

automationCalendar.description: Calendar: desktop app: Members see a Calendar in the desktop app with their Automations next to meetings from their connected Google or Outlook calendar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR.

automationIntervalSchedules.description: Automations: every few hours: Members and their agents can schedule an Automation to run every few hours, for example every 3 hours between 9:00 and 18:00 on weekdays, instead of once a day or once a week. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_INTERVAL_SCHEDULES.

automationCalendarTriggers.description: Automations: before or after meetings: Members and their agents can run a Cloud Automation a set time before or after each meeting on their Google Calendar, for example 5 minutes after every meeting with people outside the organization. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR_TRIGGERS.

computerUse.description: Computer use: Let agents use Mac apps or a managed cloud desktop with a live view and Take over and Stop controls. While enabled, requested apps and windows open directly without additional OpenWork approval prompts. GUI access is experimental and is not sandboxed by structured-tool permission rules. Renders DEN_FEATURE_COMPUTER_USE.

browserDemonstrations.description: Workbot: teach browser tasks: Demonstrate a browser task with explanations, save it as a private reusable skill, and run it with new inputs. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_DEMONSTRATIONS.

browserLiveView.description: Workbot: browser live view: Workbot's Browser view streams the browser page itself, sending a frame only when the page changes, instead of video of the whole browser window, with Workbot's own tabs to switch and close. Taking control sends input to the page, so Chrome's toolbar stays hidden. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_LIVE_VIEW.

browserFloatingView.description: Desktop: floating and full-screen browser: The built-in browser can float as a small live card over the chat, sit beside it, or fill the window, with the side rail's Browser button showing when it needs the person. Renders DEN_FEATURE_BROWSER_FLOATING_VIEW.

remoteComputers.description: Desktop: computer use on remote computers: Use a Linux cloud computer with its browser and desktop in OpenWork Web, or connect a VM from Desktop. Configured and conversation-owned desktops open directly when enabled, including follow-ups and internal session renewal. Take over and Stop stay available. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_COMPUTERS.

remoteSessionSubagents.description: Desktop: tasks on other computers as sub-agents: A task the agent starts on the cloud or another computer shows in the chat as a sub-agent row: where it runs, whether it is working, needs an answer or finished, and a Stop button. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_SUBAGENTS.

remoteSessionThreadView.description: Desktop: open a sub-agent task's conversation: Clicking the row of a task on another computer opens its conversation beside the chat, where people read it and follow up. Needs tasks on other computers as sub-agents. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_THREAD_VIEW.

activationChecklist.description: Get set up checklist: After their first answer, people see a Get set up checklist in Desktop and Workbot: invite a teammate, use a skill, add a model provider, share one on AI Gateway and connect an app, each checked off once it works. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ACTIVATION_CHECKLIST.

connectStandardTools.description: Connect: standard tools: Supported clients, including OpenWork Desktop, OpenCode and Claude Code, discover connected actions, Workflows and Apps as individual tools. Capability search uses MCP tool schemas with older fields kept for compatibility. Turning this off restores the previous search view and schemas. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CONNECT_STANDARD_TOOLS.

teamPlan.description: Team plan checkout: Going past 5 people moves the workspace to the Team plan at $10 per person per month, and paying sets the plan. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TEAM_PLAN.

selfServeEnterprise.description: Self-serve Enterprise: Owners can buy Enterprise by card at the planned per-person price. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SELF_SERVE_ENTERPRISE.

gatewayProviderAuthErrors.description: AI Gateway: rejected provider credentials in chat: When a provider rejects your organization's AI Gateway credential, the chat says which provider rejected it and asks you to contact your administrator, with a request ID for support, instead of sending you to your own model settings. Renders DEN_FEATURE_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_AUTH_ERRORS.

providerCredentialStatus.description: Desktop: honest AI provider key status: AI Providers says "Not checked yet" for a key that has not answered a chat, and "Key not accepted" with Replace key (or ask your admin, for organization providers) after the provider rejects it, instead of always "Ready to use". Renders DEN_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_STATUS.

sessionTokenHashing.description: Hashed sign-in sessions: Den keeps only a one-way hash of each sign-in session token, so a copy of the database cannot sign anyone in. New sessions are stored hashed and older ones convert the next time they are used; turn on only once every Den replica runs a release that reads both forms. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SESSION_TOKEN_HASHING.

lastUsedSignIn.description: Remember last sign-in method: People who last signed in with a password, Google or GitHub skip the email step next time: Den web lists the sign-in methods with a Last used badge, and Single sign-on returns to the email step. Signing in with SSO forgets the method. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LAST_USED_SIGN_IN.
